summary: Comprehensive testing of Week Release and Coach Max features. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - Student dashboard shows only released weeks, status badges work correctly, feedback expands with Ask Coach Max button, Coach Max chat opens with welcome message and input field. Instructor CohortDetail shows week toggle buttons (Eye/EyeOff) that properly control visibility.
